text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a cup. Another key task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in an image at the same time. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect pedestrians and other vehicles. Thanks to computer vision, machines can now understand the visual world around them.
